name: weft-canvas
description: Weft for local use: the canvas app (weft serve), the agent Skill that edits it, and the why layer over local Claude Code, Codex and DeepSeek Harness sessions. Source files are never written.

scripts.build: cd .. && npm run cli:build && npm run host:build
scripts.build:package: npm run build && cd .. && npm run build && npm run serve:build
scripts.postpack: rm -rf skill host-dist scripts app commands
scripts.test: npm run build && npm --prefix .. run desktop:why && node --test test/*.test.mjs
